summary: SF_WINDOW_INT_NC_v1 draft artifacts (research, resolution, materials, sop_modules, production) pass all critical doctrine checks. 29 tasks thread correctly between sop_modules.json and production.json. Registry compliance verified — no prohibited patterns found. Fine Finish Doctrine and Window Systems Doctrine compliance confirmed. Combined prime+paint module structure correctly implemented with conditional primer. EA-based counting with size bucket, window type, muntin, and 5-tier height modifiers all present. 4 minor warnings and 2 informational notes flagged for review. All artifacts remain DRAFT pending human review and spec.json assembly.

issues.description: 12 binary tasks missing defect_tolerance definitions: TSK_WIN_FLOOR_PROTECT, TSK_WIN_GLASS_MASK, TSK_WIN_HARDWARE_PROTECT, TSK_WIN_WALL_MASK, TSK_WIN_SILL_PROTECT, TSK_WIN_PREP_SCUFF, TSK_WIN_PREP_METAL_DEGREASE, TSK_WIN_PREP_ALUMINUM_ETCH, TSK_WIN_PREP_CLEAN, TSK_WIN_CLEAN_INTERSTAGE, TSK_WIN_PROTECT_TEARDOWN, TSK_WIN_CLEAN_TOOLS. Defect tolerance is most meaningful for application/inspection tasks (which are covered) but doctrine recommends it for every task.
issues.suggested_fix: Add defect_tolerance to missing tasks. For protection/cleanup tasks, defect_tolerance can be simple (e.g., 'Complete coverage of all protection zones').

issues.description: Size bucket modifiers (S=0.75, M=1.00, L=1.40) and window type modifiers (DH=1.00, casement=0.96, slider=0.96, fixed=0.78, awning=1.00) are in production.json but NOT in Modifier_Registry.md. These are window-specific modifiers that should be centrally registered for single-source-of-truth consistency.
issues.suggested_fix: Add 'Window Size Bucket Modifiers' and 'Window Type Modifiers' sections to Modifier_Registry.md. Values: SIZE_S=0.75, SIZE_M=1.00, SIZE_L=1.40, TYPE_DH=1.00, TYPE_CASEMENT=0.96, TYPE_SLIDER=0.96, TYPE_FIXED=0.78, TYPE_AWNING=1.00.

issues.description: 5 doctrine gap assumptions in production.json (A-001 through A-005). Size bucket modifiers (A-001), task rate decomposition (A-003), coat 3 rates (A-004), and glass masking SF rate (A-005) all lack canonical doctrine backing. These are research-derived estimates that need field validation.
issues.suggested_fix: Flag for validation per production.json validation_plan. After field validation, update doctrine if rates are confirmed or adjust production rates if they differ from practice.

issues.description: MOD_WIN_PRIME applies_when uses non-standard keys (condition, primer_required_when, primer_skipped_when) instead of the standard enum-based applies_when pattern. While descriptive, the estimation engine needs explicit logic to evaluate these conditions. The standard applies_when pattern would use substrate_state enum.
issues.suggested_fix: No structural change needed — the applies_when clearly documents the primer conditionality. Engine integration should parse 'substrate_state = SS_BARE OR substrate in [aluminum, steel]' as primer trigger. Document this conditional module pattern in structural_keys.json for future combined specs.

doctrine_checks.details: No geometry computation in any artifact. All geometry sourced from PaintScope inputs (EA window counts, SF glass area, LF wall/sill masking).
All 17 required inputs declared with paintscope_key mappings in materials, sop_modules, and production.
All 29 tasks have unit_of_measure declared (EA, SF, LF, FIXED).
All production rates match task UOM. EA tasks have EA/hr rates, SF tasks have SF/hr rates, LF tasks have LF/hr rates, FIXED has fixed_time_minutes.
No edge tasks in this spec. Wall masking is protection work, not edge work. Window-to-glass interface is masking, not cut-in.
All inputs flow PaintScope → spec inputs → task rates. No bypass. Size bucket counts → per-EA rates. Glass SF → masking rate.
No human feedback gate completed yet. Research.json is DRAFT awaiting human review. All downstream artifacts are also DRAFT.
Pending human review of all artifacts.
All authority drawn from doctrine docs (Window_Systems_Doctrine, Fine_Finish_Doctrine, Modifier_Registry). Trim spec used for STRUCTURAL pattern only, not production rate precedent.
Wall masking has PS_PROTECT_LF.WALL_ADJACENT_WINDOW, sill protection has PS_PROTECT_LF.SILL. All protection steps have measurable PaintScope inputs.
All 6 protection zones have measurable inputs: glass (SF), floor_perimeter (SF), floor_8ft_radius (SF), wall_adjacent_window (LF), hardware_covers (EA), sill (LF).
No LF↔SF derivation. Window area estimated via size bucket perimeter math (Area = P²÷16) but this is done by PaintScope, not the spec.

production.json rate_notes explicitly states: 'effective_time = base_time × modifier_product. For ea_per_hour rates: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier_product.' All modifiers documented as time multipliers.
All 29 tasks in sop_modules.json have task_classification defined (20 binary, 9 qt_scaled).
task_classification matches between sop_modules.json and production.json for all 29 tasks. Binary tasks use rate_per_hour, qt_scaled tasks use qt_rates.
All 20 binary tasks have single rate_per_hour (or fixed_time_minutes). None have qt_rates.
All 9 qt_scaled tasks have qt_rates with QT3, QT4, QT5 entries.
12 of 29 tasks missing defect_tolerance. Present on all application, inspection, and sanding tasks. Missing on protection, cleanup, and prep utility tasks. See QA-001.
MOD_WIN_INTERSTAGE exists with 5 tasks (inspect, sand, patch, spot coat, clean). Follows Fine Finish interstage pattern.
run_rule: 'Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat'. run_count_formula: 'total_coats - 1'. Correct per FFD 5.3.

Sheen/QT gate in resolution.json: satin at QT3+, semi-gloss at QT4+, gloss at QT5 only. materials.json allowed_sheens match: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC=[satin], SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE=[satin, semi-gloss], SYS_FF_PREMIUM=[satin, semi-gloss, gloss].
qt_scaled tasks use explicit qt_rates with scrutiny-based notes. Not simple QT modifier multiplication.
Rigid sanding block mandate (FFD 15.4.1) referenced in sanding task descriptions and production rate basis notes.
All finish coat and primer tasks are binary (same quality at all tiers). defect_tolerance says 'Application quality is NOT tiered' for all application tasks.
'Apply, tip once, walk away' documented in finish coat module and task descriptions per FFD 15.3.1.
ROUND_WIN_3FINISH round configuration supports QT5 brush/roll 3+ coats per FFD 15.10.3.
MOD_WIN_PREP has substrate-conditional tasks: wood (sand, fill), aluminum (degrease, etch), steel (degrease, rust treatment). Correct per Window_Systems_Doctrine Sections 3, 6.2, 6.3.
MOD_WIN_PRIME is conditional on substrate_state=SS_BARE (wood) or substrate=aluminum/steel. Skipped when SS_PRIMED_FACTORY. Correct per Window_Systems_Doctrine and research RF-002.
4 primer systems in materials.json are substrate-driven (wood acrylic, wood shellac, aluminum DTM, steel DTM). Primer is NOT QT-driven. Correct per Window_Systems_Doctrine Sections 3, 6.
TSK_WIN_GLASS_MASK has no applies_when restriction — runs at all tiers and all methods. protection_metadata.method_dependent=false. Correct per research RF-007.
Blocking prevention notes in all finish coat task descriptions: 'paint sashes in ajar position', 'do NOT close before full cure (3-7 days for enamels)'. Per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 10.1.
TSK_WIN_GLASS_SCRAPE is in MOD_WIN_CLEANUP (cleanup phase), not interstage. Notes 'occurs AFTER full cure'. Per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 4.1.1.
5-tier height system (H1-H5) in production.json matches Modifier_Registry v1.2: H1=1.00, H2=1.30, H3=1.50, H4=2.00, H5=2.50. PaintScope keys PS_OPENING_EA.WINDOW_H1-H5 all present.
Size bucket modifiers (S, M, L, O) defined in production.json. EA-based counting with size modifier. M is baseline. Per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 7 and PaintScope_Window_Counting_System.
5 window type modifiers (DH, casement, slider, fixed, awning) defined in production.json. Values normalized from Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 8.3 rates.
Muntin modifier 1.20x defined in production.json. Applies to application and sanding tasks. Does not apply to setup/cleanup. Per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 8.3.
materials.json has dual system: 4 primer systems (substrate-driven) + 3 finish systems (QT-driven). Any primer can pair with any finish. Correct architecture per research RF-009.
1.5" angled sash brush for detail work and 2-2.5" for frame faces documented in SOP and production tasks. Per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 8.2.1.
20-40% spray material waste documented in materials.json coverage profiles and production rate notes. Per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 8.2.2.
5 protection setup tasks and 1 teardown task have protection_metadata with action and zones fields.
All protection_metadata.action values are 'setup' or 'teardown' — valid enum.
Zone IDs floor_perimeter, floor_full_8ft_radius, glass_mask, hardware_covers, wall_adjacent_window, sill_protection all in resolution.json zone_ids.
TSK_WIN_PROTECT_TEARDOWN covers all 5 non-glass zones. Glass masking teardown handled by TSK_WIN_GLASS_SCRAPE. All zones paired.
Protection tasks have site_condition_rules (floor_type include/exclude). State condition notes for wall masking and sill protection.
Condition IDs (floor_type) and values (finished, partial, subfloor) valid per Site_Condition_Vocabulary_Reference.
QT modifiers (1.00/1.30/1.50), height modifiers (1.00/1.30/1.50/2.00/2.50), condition modifiers (1.00/1.50/2.00) match Modifier_Registry.md v1.2 exactly.
Valid input states: SS_BARE, SS_PRIMED_FACTORY. Both are valid SS_* IDs in Substrate_State_Reference.
Output states: SS_PAINTED_SATIN, SS_PAINTED_SEMIGLOSS, SS_PAINTED_GLOSS. All valid SS_* IDs.
State map (satin→SS_PAINTED_SATIN, semi-gloss→SS_PAINTED_SEMIGLOSS, gloss→SS_PAINTED_GLOSS) in resolution.json is valid.
Wall masking and sill protection have substrate_state_rules with protect_when_state and skip_when_state. Valid SS_* IDs used.
